skill_name: Research and describe the historical context which led to the creation of the World Trade Organization
workflow: The World Trade Organization (WTO) was created out of the Uruguay Round of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) in 1994. The Uruguay Round began in 1986 and was aimed at liberalizing global trade through multilateral agreements and regulations. This was done by reducing tariffs, removing barriers and other government interventions, increasing intellectual property rights, and opening agriculture and services markets to international investment and competition.
